title: Зведена інформація щодо діяльності угрупування UAC-0006 станом на 01.12.2023

entities.name: UAC-0006
entities.gloss: A financially motivated cybercriminal group active since 2013 targeting Ukrainian organizations.

entities.name: SMOKELOADER
entities.gloss: A modular malware downloader used to drop and execute secondary payloads.

entities.name: LOADERX3
entities.gloss: A malware loader used to deploy subsequent malicious components on infected systems.

entities.name: RMS
entities.gloss: A legitimate remote administration utility often abused by threat actors for unauthorized access.

entities.name: RDPWRAPPER
entities.gloss: A software library used to enable Remote Desktop Host support on Windows workstations.

entities.name: DANABOT
entities.gloss: A modular banking Trojan and information stealer.

entities.name: LUMMASTEALER
entities.gloss: An information stealer malware targeting credentials, cryptocurrency wallets, and browser data.

entities.name: REDLINESTEALER
entities.gloss: A commercial information stealer malware that harvests credentials, cookies, and system information.

entities.name: SYSTEMBC
entities.gloss: A proxy and backdoor malware used to route malicious traffic and maintain access.

entities.name: TALESHOT
entities.gloss: A spyware tool used to capture screenshots and analyze active window titles and processes.

entities.name: PIEJET
entities.gloss: A Python-based malicious loader or script used by cybercriminals.

entities.name: LOADNEST
entities.gloss: A malware loader designed to deploy additional malicious payloads.

entities.name: HANGTHREAD
entities.gloss: A specialized tool designed to cause denial of service by exhausting computing resources.

entities.name: BACKSTAB
entities.gloss: A tool used by threat actors to disable security software processes using legitimate signed drivers.

entities.name: AUKILL
entities.gloss: A defense evasion tool used to disable endpoint detection and response (EDR) software.

entities.name: Windows
entities.gloss: A series of proprietary graphical operating systems developed and marketed by Microsoft.

relations.head: UAC-0006
relations.evidence: угрупування UAC-0006 посідає перше місце в категорії фінансових злочинів, здійснюючи (спроби) викрадення грошових коштів з рахунків українських підприємств
